# bioexcel/biobb_dna/interhpcorr

## Summary

Calculate correlation between helical parameters for a single inter-base pair.

Calculate correlation between helical parameters for a single inter-base pair.

Nextflow adapter of the [InterHelParCorrelation](https://biobb-dna.readthedocs.io/en/latest/interbp_correlations.html#interbp-correlations-interhpcorr-module) building block of [biobb_dna](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_dna) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_DNA_INTERHPCORR } from 'bioexcel/biobb_dna/interhpcorr'

workflow {
    BIOBB_DNA_INTERHPCORR(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_filename_shift` | yes | csv | Path to .csv file with data for helical parameter 'shift' |
| `input_filename_slide` | yes | csv | Path to .csv file with data for helical parameter 'slide' |
| `input_filename_rise` | yes | csv | Path to .csv file with data for helical parameter 'rise' |
| `input_filename_tilt` | yes | csv | Path to .csv file with data for helical parameter 'tilt' |
| `input_filename_roll` | yes | csv | Path to .csv file with data for helical parameter 'roll' |
| `input_filename_twist` | yes | csv | Path to .csv file with data for helical parameter 'twist' |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_csv_path` | yes | csv | Path to directory where output is saved |
| `output_jpg_path` | yes | jpg | Path to .jpg file where output is saved |
| `versions_biobb_dna` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_dna', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of InterHelParCorrelation properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_csv_path: 'csv']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_dna container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_DNA_INTERHPCORR' {
        ext.properties = [remove_tmp: true]
    }
}
```

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `basepair` | string | null | Name of basepair analyzed. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
